body:
**Handoff from MMR-66 (display-copy memory).**

- **The scene holds every settlement entity twice.** A periodic world gets one display copy per settlement, so the copy cost scales with the settlement count.
- **Fixture budget** (run 33944, `evidence/world/periodic-camera-picking.json` `budget`):
  - 4 copies, 50 registered entities in `MapScreen.VisualsOfEntities`, 370 scene root entities;
  - 20 camera wraps and two party crossings left all of them unchanged;
  - managed memory +83 KB; private bytes −122 MB (noise).
- **No memory limit exists yet.** MMR-21 recorded no visible-copy memory limit, so MMR-66 judged only non-growth.
- **What MMR-56 should measure on a full-size world:** copy entity count, `VisualsOfEntities` size and the private-bytes delta from the copies (`PeriodicMapPresentation.Copies`). It should also set the limit.
- **Per-frame cost** comes from the display-rule postfixes on every visible party visual and nameplate, plus `RefreshImages` on camera wraps or moves over 50 units. It has not been profiled.
